value.rationale: The first invisible quadratic Fourier characters of a canonical Catalan descent-profile family occur at a precisely determined natural order, while every linear character at that order remains observable. The all-length equality of adjacent and nonadjacent positional characters provides a structural two-point correlation identity, and the exhaustive four-mode boundary is a concrete low-degree recoverability fact rather than a generic Catalan-number exercise.
